q: Give me a read on September: what worked, what didn't, and what should we change for November?
answer:
Verdict: September saw sharply lower activity but cleaner economics — orders and net sales fell ~44.5% vs the prior month (orders 931, net sales ₹15,74,765) while ad delivery fell harder and ROAS improved. On an attributed basis the ad portfolio returned ₹10,34,955 on ₹9,13,327 spend = 1.13x (ad spend = delivery date, revenue = order date), and 9 campaigns spent ₹1,40,837 (13.4% of spend) with no orders.

What is working
- Clear winners with enough scale: TH-383-SUSPENDER-17JULY-ADV+ (₹31,675 net sales on ₹15,935 spend = 1.99x, 16 orders); TH-284-CRABDASH TOY and TH-336-PAWTECH-26SEP also show healthy ROI (1.8x and 1.7x with ≥7 orders). Scale these first.

Where money is leaking
- No-orders spend: 9 campaigns consumed ₹1,40,837 (13.4% of September spend) but recorded zero orders — obvious reallocation candidates.
- Evidenced losers: TH-054-TOTE-1SEP lost ~₹10,135 (net sales ₹10,409 on spend ₹20,544, 12 orders); several campaigns return <1x and should be cut or reworked.
- Concentration: three campaigns account for ~28% of spend — check their efficiency before further scaling.

Why (data-backed)
- Ad spend dropped ~45.9% vs prior period (ad spend (P&L basis) ₹11,93,322 vs ₹22,03,894 prior). Sales/orders also fell ~44.5% (net sales ₹15,74,765 vs ₹28,35,191), so the primary driver of lower revenue was materially lower spend; because spend fell more than sales, net ROAS and net profit improved (net profit moved from -₹7,73,786 to -₹2,86,297).

What I would do for November (in order of money at stake)
1. Reclaim no-orders spend: pause or sharply reduce bids on the 9 no-order campaigns (₹1,40,837). Check: if a campaign still shows 0 orders in 3 days, keep paused; reallocate to top performers.  
2. Scale proven winners by +20–40% of their current spend (start with TH-383-SUSPENDER and the two listed above). Check: target same or better ROAS and stable CPA over 7 days.  
3. Cut or rework losing campaigns (TH-054-TOTE and others returning <1x): reduce spend by 50% and test alternate creative/landing pages. Check: CPA falls or ROAS moves >1.0 within 7–14 days before re-scaling.  
4. Audit high-spend Demand Gen/brand buckets with big drops (e.g., [Google Build] Demand Gen spent ₹71,444 with no orders): review audience/creative and tracking attribution; if tracking is correct, reallocate to demand-capture (search/PMax) until performance proven.

Notes
- Basis: revenue and orders are by order date (commerce); ad spend rows are platform delivery date (paid_media). The portfolio ROI quoted (1.13x) uses attributed net sales ÷ ad spend (campaign rows), not P&L reconciliation.  
- Totals: Orders 931 · Net sales ₹15,74,765 · Portfolio ad spend (campaign rows) ₹10,54,164 · Ad spend (P&L view) ₹11,93,322 · Net profit (order-date) -₹2,86,297. Brand scoped to default (Tilting Heads). Data as of latest sync.

Period: 2026-09-01..2026-09-30 · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-28
